title: Add Real or AI? — Spot the Synthetic to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Real or AI? — Spot the Synthetic](https://spot-the-ai.edgeone.dev) to games
- Real or AI? is a timed browser game where players see two matched images or two matched passages — one real, one AI-generated — and must spot the fake before the clock runs out. 3 hearts, streak multi

Fixes #15790, fixes #15725

gist.headline: Spot the synthetic
gist.blurb: A new game joins the garden: pick the real image or passage from a matched pair before the timer runs out. Three hearts make every guess count.
gist.summary: Real or AI? — Spot the Synthetic joins the games list with timed rounds of matched images or passages, one real and one AI-generated, plus three hearts and streak scoring.
gist.impact: Players get a quick visual-and-text guessing game where they identify the AI-generated entry before time runs out.
gist.visual_concept: Real or AI? is a browser guessing game with no mascot identified in the PR. Show Polli as a tiny detective comparing two image cards beside two passage cards, with a pixel timer, three hearts, and a streak marker; flowers and code-plants keep the scene rooted in the pollinations garden.
